assets.name: skyline-harbor
assets.prompt: Original high-quality pixel-art background panorama for a cyberpunk town game. Crisp deliberate pixels, layered architectural detail, deep midnight navy shadows, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no characters, no close foreground props. A wide side/front skyline viewed straight across the district. The whole image must tile continuously LEFT TO RIGHT: identical horizon and illumination at both side edges, continuous cloud bands, no framing border or vignette, no unique giant landmark cut in half at either edge. Fill the full canvas; opaque image. Composition: sky in upper quarter, layered district silhouettes and neon windows in middle half, bottom quarter fading gradually into uniform very dark ink navy #101323 so town foreground can sit in front. Output panoramic1536×512, aspect3:1. Keep the skyline detail readable but calmer and darker than foreground buildings. District: neon harbor. Cyan-lit cargo docks, distant container stacks, angular gantry cranes and slim harbor control towers, restrained cyan #49dcd7 with occasional amber safety lights. Quiet dark water reflections between the docks and the bottom fade. A few low maritime structures and distant mist; no boats as close focal objects. Distinct spacious harbor silhouette, cool teal atmosphere.

assets.name: plaza-seamless
assets.prompt: Original pixel-art cyberpunk plaza pavement texture strip for a town game. Requested output1536×384, aspect4:1. Top-down to very slightly oblique view matching game ground tiles; no vanishing point. Opaque full canvas, predominantly very dark midnight navy/charcoal paving, clearly DARKER and quieter than a neon roadway. Rectangular worn stone/metal pavers, tiny seams, occasional muted cyan and warm amber light pools, a few restrained damp reflections. Sparse small cyberpunk planters and two low benches only near the upper-quarter margin, away from left/right seams; keep the central and lower75% broadly empty unobstructed paving for house fronts, station props and walking characters. No people, robots, cars, roads, lane markings, text, letters, logos, UI or huge props. Crisp high-quality pixel art. Texture repeats LEFT TO RIGHT with matched tile spacing, brightness and pavement alignment at side edges, no border/vignette. Also keep top/bottom pavement color compatible. Sparse understated details; calm empty ground is the main subject.

processing.method: Aspect-preserving top crop; nearest-neighbor normalization;128px horizontal overlap blend of generated final/initial strips; retained middle plus blend produces1536px loop. All source artwork preserved separately.
processing.validation: Two horizontally repeated tiles and native join crops inspected; seam metrics compare RGB edge jumps. Vertical tiling is not asserted.

validation_review.visual_result: Two repeated tiles inspected for all four assets; native-size join crops inspected for uptown, industrial and plaza. No hard vertical boundary observed.128px overlap introduces a small blended architecture/paver region; this is packaged horizontal continuity, not a claim of pixel-identical generated edges.
validation_review.vertical_tiling: Not required or validated; these are horizontal strips.
